description: This script contains a test suite for git's merge functionality, specifically testing how symlinks are handled when core.symlinks is false. It sets up repositories, creates commits with symlinks and files, and tests the merge behavior to ensure symlinks are merged as plain files under specified configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command and expects it to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
